meta.source: Derived from a supplied reference landing page (sky field, lime accent, ink pills, mono micro-labels) and adapted for a scientific analysis product.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every workspace.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Soft grey cards and panels sitting on bg; table header rows.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards placed on surface (a white card inside a grey panel); menus and popovers.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: inputs, code, the track of progress and interval bars.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines that carry no meaning on their own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and outline buttons; at least 3:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on bg, surface, surface-raised and the tints.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, surface and surface-raised: descriptions, table cells.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, units and timestamps on bg and surface (5.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-pill
tokens.usage: Fill of the ink button and the dark metric card; inverts in the dark theme.

tokens.name: on-ink-pill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink-pill fill.

tokens.name: sky-500
tokens.usage: Brand sky: hero fields, the brand mark, chart emphasis. White text on it only at 24px and larger (3.5:1).

tokens.name: sky-wash
tokens.usage: Lower stop of the sky hero field and large decorative sky areas. Never a text ground for small text.

tokens.name: sky-strong
tokens.usage: Fill of the sky button and selected segments; text on it is on-sky-strong.

tokens.name: on-sky-strong
tokens.usage: Text on sky-strong fills (6:1 or better).

tokens.name: sky-text
tokens.usage: Links and info text on bg, surface and sky-tint.

tokens.name: sky-tint
tokens.usage: Info alerts, the selected table row, the measured-value band in charts.

tokens.name: lime-400
tokens.usage: The primary action fill and one highlight per view (the lime metric card). Text on it is on-lime.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text and icons on lime-400 (15:1).

tokens.name: lime-text
tokens.usage: Lime-family text on bg, surface and lime-tint; also the predicted quantity colour.

tokens.name: lime-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for predicted-value tags and the prediction interval band.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Operational / completed status text and dots, on bg, surface and ok-tint. Teal toward blue so it never pairs with danger on the red-green axis; always with a word.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of ok pills and success alerts.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Degraded / warning status text and dots on bg, surface and warn-tint; always with a word.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of warning pills and warning alerts.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Unavailable / failed status and errors on bg, surface and bad-tint; always with a word.

tokens.name: bad-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of error pills and error alerts.

tokens.name: q-measured
tokens.usage: Quantity class: direct measurements and image-derived values. Solid chart lines and tag text on bg and sky-tint.

tokens.name: q-calculated
tokens.usage: Quantity class: values calculated from measurements with a stated model (mm conversion, derivatives, equivalent volume).

tokens.name: q-predicted
tokens.usage: Quantity class: model predictions. Dashed chart lines; tag text on lime-tint.

tokens.name: q-simulated
tokens.usage: Quantity class: synthetic or simulated data. Always with the word SYNTHETIC.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series (comparisons); 5:1 on bg.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series (comparisons); 6.6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: overlay-contour
tokens.usage: Detected flame boundary drawn over camera frames (7.5:1 or better on dark video).

tokens.name: overlay-limb
tokens.usage: Fitted shell-limb circle over camera frames.

tokens.name: overlay-centroid
tokens.usage: Centroid cross and frame readouts over camera frames.

tokens.name: overlay-warn
tokens.usage: Rejected or low-confidence detections over camera frames.

tokens.name: video-ground
tokens.usage: Letterbox and viewer background around camera frames, both themes.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px keyboard focus ring with a 2px bg gap; 4.7:1 or better on bg, surface and lime-400.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One headline per page at most: Mission Control hero, presentation mode.

styles.name: metric-xl
styles.usage: The figure in a metric card; tabular numerals.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The shell-limb radius is the outer half-maximum edge of the luminous shell.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase micro-labels: navigation, eyebrows, column headers, tags. Always set in uppercase.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and readouts; IDs; units.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field label to input; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on dense panels; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero padding; separation of major regions.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of a page below the app bar.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags inside tables, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, segmented controls, square buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels nested inside cards, video viewer, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and metric cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The sky hero frame and full-width bands.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, status pills, nav items.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Only on surface-raised cards that float over the sky field or over video.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs.
